en-US.name: Campus Companion
en-US.summary: Voice assistant for campus class schedules, dynamic assignment deadlines, and daily reminders.
en-US.description: Campus Companion helps students keep track of their schedule, ask 'What is my next class?', dynamically calculate and store assignment due dates with daily reminders ('I have to submit DBMS assignment within 5 days'), and clear completed tasks.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask campus companion what is my next class
Alexa, tell campus companion I have to submit DBMS assignment within 5 days

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Test with 'What is my next class?', 'I have to submit DBMS assignment within 5 days', 'DBMS assignment is completed', and 'What are my reminders?'.
